legacy.labels: source-window association only; permitted matrix entries are not event-positive labels
legacy.fixed_path_scope: full-head hard path locked; clock-only geometric template independent of content
legacy.optimized_difference_scope: intervention, not additive causal content contribution

train.scope: same music/choreography/source clock repeated capture proxy, not frame-exact human motion correspondence

val.scope: same music/choreography/source clock repeated capture proxy, not frame-exact human motion correspondence

information.fitting: Train-only closed-form ridge, no neural optimizer
information.targets: numerical acoustic reconstruction / fixed-offset FK speed / detector proxies; no human event correspondence
information.causal_scope: linear accessibility on common real grid; not proof of semantic information destruction

gradients.scope: one SGD-like hypothetical step on independent clones at registered step; not deployed training or Val selection

input_scope: preverified paired AIST Train/Val; cache reused; no new blind source; no raw data publication
